responsibility: Defines the built-in target specification for RISC-V RV32IMC with ESP-IDF, configuring the Espressif/newlib platform identity, GCC-based linking via `riscv32-esp-elf-gcc`, a generic RV32 CPU baseline with `mc` features, static relocation, abort-on-panic behavior, and libcalls-backed 32-bit atomic/CAS support for the standard library.
